resources.string: Drag the handles to adjust hue, saturation and lightness.
Tap the palette below to choose a color and line width.
Choose a color and width, then tap Apply. Try a few strokes on the canvas.
Draw a little, then press and hold the palette below until the ring fills.
Ask someone to think of a number from 1 to 9. Pretend to sketch it, then reveal their number on the canvas.
First, try the pen settings. Then learn the secret hold and practice revealing a number. These tips disappear during a real performance.
The next screen only looks switched off. It is still listening.\n\nDouble-tap the area for a number to reveal its drawing. First, follow the highlighted guide. Then try number 8 yourself.
